list.title: Trial batches
list.subtitle: Scale any saved version out to a manufacturing run. Locks against the frozen snapshot so future catalogue edits cannot rewrite the BOM.
list.empty: No trial batches yet — plan one to see the procurement BOM.
list.delete_confirm: Delete this trial batch? The underlying formulation version is not affected.

create.title: Plan batch — {formulation}
create.subtitle: Pick a saved version and choose Trial (bench-scale test, bypasses Final Release) or Sample (full commercial-path pack production).
create.approved_hint: Pre-selected the approved version (v{version}). Override only if you know you need a draft.
create.kind_trial_hint: Bench-scale test — the number IS the raw count of finished capsules / tablets / scoops. PSP MO bypasses Final Release and returns to R&D on QC pass.
create.kind_sample_hint: Customer-sample production — multiplies by the formulation's units per pack. PSP MO follows the full commercial release path.
create.packaging_none_hint: MO runs the recipe stages but skips packaging — the output is loose bulk (capsules in a bag, powder in a jar).
create.packaging_empty_hint: This formulation has no packaging combos defined yet. Add them on the Builder → Packaging tab if you want to run a packed sample.
create.batch_size_hint: Number of bottles / pouches / tubs the batch ships. The BOM math multiplies this by the formulation's units per pack.
create.batch_size_unit_hint: Exact count of capsules / tablets / scoops / gummies — no pack multiplier.
create.label: Label
create.invalid_input: Pick a version and enter a positive batch size.

column_hint.material: Raw-material name as it appears in the BOM.
column_hint.mg_per_unit: Milligrams of this raw material in one finished {unit}.
column_hint.g_per_pack: Grams of this raw material in one pack ({perPack} {unit}s per pack).
column_hint.bom: Grams of this raw material in 1 kg of finished blend. The weight column sums to exactly 1 000 g.
column_hint.kg_per_batch: Total grams (or count) needed for the whole batch run.
column_hint.actual: Empty column for the technician to write the actual weighed amount in pen — in grams.
